promise: One assistant that remembers what matters, organizes ongoing work, delegates to the right agents, and follows through.

lanes.A: Lane A: core contracts, durable entities and events (existing backend worker)
lanes.B: Lane B: local assistant runtime and evaluation (existing runtime worker)
lanes.C: Lane C: built-in web app shell and UX (existing UI worker)
lanes.R: Independent reviewer: acceptance suite and reviews (existing review worker)

items.title: Product charter, repo audit and deduplicated delivery map
items.scope: Inventory shipped, partial and absent capabilities, open changes and reuse decisions; baseline supervisory effort and status correctness; record non-goals.
items.next: Commit this plan and backlog; create the tracker epic and items; dispatch lanes A, B, C and the reviewer.

items.title: Shared architecture and UX contract (ADR)
items.scope: Assistant identity; ordinary chat vs durable project; Project, Task, Thread/Subthread, Workspace, Memory, Decision, Event, Action/Approval; API contracts; basic user journeys; feature flag.
acceptance: Migration strategy reusing the agent-job store, threads, task agents and events
Sample flows and wireframes in the existing web design
items.next: Draft docs/adr/0002-personal-agent-contract.md from the audit; lanes B and C comment before freeze.

items.title: Durable project/task/resource entities and additive migration
items.scope: Additive Project/Task/resource records next to existing threads, task agents and agent-job runs; preserve ids, histories, thread bindings, owners and repo/desk attachments.
acceptance: Migration dry run on sanitized fixtures
No production migration in this task
items.next: Blocked on OP-02 contract freeze.

items.title: Explicit task contracts and lifecycle
items.scope: Outcome, criteria, scope/permissions, dependencies, assigned worker, priority, budget, evidence, next action; queued/running/blocked/needs-approval/succeeded/failed/cancelled with validated transitions.
acceptance: Worker 'done' text alone cannot mark success
items.next: Blocked on OP-03.

items.title: Unified event journal and reliable dispatch
items.scope: Correlate message/task/worker/tool/action/artifact events with actor origin, timestamp, causation and idempotency keys; reuse events.jsonl, orkestr-events, outbox and effect ledgers; add a cursor feed.
acceptance: Uncertain external effects never blindly retried
items.next: Blocked on OP-03; event envelope is specified in OP-02.

items.title: Project/task projections and evidence-backed status API
items.scope: Durable snapshots with last verified progress, blockers, next action and source events.
acceptance: No full-history scan or invented completion
items.next: Blocked on OP-04 and OP-05.

items.title: Persistent assistant memory and context assembly
items.scope: Separate approved preferences, facts, decisions, commitments and project summaries with provenance, timestamps, correction/forget/export, scoped retrieval and bounded context. Reuse the appendable open-topics ledger pattern already used privately.
acceptance: Arbitrary web/agent text is never promoted to owner instructions
items.next: Blocked on OP-02 memory contract and OP-03 storage.

items.title: Single top-level conversational agent
items.scope: Normal dialogue, recall, cross-project questions, commitments capture, delegation, explaining blockers and approvals via projections and tools.
acceptance: 'remember this', 'what is blocked', 'start this', 'cancel that' and ordinary chat work
items.next: Blocked on OP-06, OP-07 and OP-09.

items.title: Local inference adapter and health/configuration
items.scope: Provider-neutral adapter over existing local serving (OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. an already-running Ollama); fill the validated but unregistered openai-compatible adapter slot; discovery, streaming, cancellation, tool/schema validation, health.
acceptance: Working local-only conversation on available hardware/model
Unavailable model handled without fabricated replies or silent cloud use
items.next: Discovery: inventory installed local models and endpoints, measure a baseline, propose the adapter interface for OP-02.

items.title: Explicit escalation, privacy and resource policies
items.scope: Optional remote models/workers with allowed data scopes, cost/token/time caps and visible reason; hard local-only setting.
acceptance: Forbidden cloud requests blocked in tests
Missing credentials, timeout and budget exhaustion handled
items.next: Policy contract drafted inside OP-02; implementation blocked on OP-09 and OP-14.

items.title: Local-model and orchestration evaluation harness
items.scope: Versioned fixtures: dialogue, memory, routing, stale status, conflicting instruction sources, delegation, approvals, EN/TR/DE, recovery.
acceptance: Report model/version/hardware, task success, latency/RAM/cost, escalation rate
items.next: Harness design starts with OP-09 discovery; final run blocked on OP-08..10.

items.title: Delegation lifecycle and bounded subthreads
items.scope: Attach work to parent contracts, isolate child context, return structured results/artifacts, propagate state; reuse thread workers, task agents and watches.
items.next: Blocked on OP-04, OP-05 and OP-14.

items.title: Supervisor and event-driven follow-through
items.scope: Heartbeats/progress leases, stall detection, bounded retry for safe actions, escalation, scheduled briefings, low-noise notifications.
acceptance: No wakeup storms or idle token burn
items.next: Blocked on OP-06 and OP-12.

items.title: Task-scoped permissions and approval evidence
items.scope: Reuse policy, agent-job tool decisions and approvals; bind approval to action, target, scope and expiry; distinguish human instruction, delegated context, automation and untrusted content.
acceptance: No external side effect outside task permission
items.next: Contract within OP-02; implementation blocked on OP-04.

items.title: Git workspace integration
items.scope: Attach repos/branches/worktrees and PR/test artifacts to tasks via existing workers and the release train.
items.next: Blocked on OP-12 and OP-14.

items.title: Virtual desk integration
items.scope: Reuse desk leases, browser access and the owner password handoff branch; expose desk ownership, blocked credentials and conflicts.
acceptance: Owner intervention shown in the parent task
items.next: Blocked on OP-12 and OP-14; reuses the reviewed password-handoff work, no duplicate.

items.title: Channel parity and identity continuity
items.scope: Web and current messaging/MCP inputs share assistant and task state; preserve routing contracts and origin/recipient metadata.
items.next: Blocked on OP-05, OP-08 and OP-14.

items.title: Personal-agent home in the existing web app
items.scope: Primary conversation plus active work, needs attention, recent results and grounded briefing, behind a feature flag; legacy threads stay reachable.
acceptance: Live events and real API data, no fake counters
items.next: Shell discovery and flagged layout against the OP-02 draft; integration blocked on OP-06 and OP-08.

items.title: Project/work detail view
items.scope: Tasks/subthreads, dependencies, timeline, outputs, repo/worktree/PR and desk attachments, blocker and next action.
acceptance: Permitted pause/cancel controls without reading every chat
items.next: Blocked on OP-12, OP-15, OP-16 and OP-18.

items.title: Approval inbox and inspectable memory/settings
items.scope: Review exact action/scope, approve/deny, edit/forget memories, inspect sources, configure autonomy/local/cloud/budgets.
items.next: Blocked on OP-07, OP-14 and OP-18.

items.title: Opinionated first-run onboarding
items.scope: Single-user default, detected local runtime, model/data tradeoffs, optional providers, guided first useful task.
items.next: Blocked on OP-09, OP-18 and OP-20.

items.title: Independent acceptance and regression suite
items.scope: End-to-end tests conversation -> task -> worker -> artifact -> verified summary; restart, failed/unknown tool call, permission denial, prompt injection, model loss, stale desk, duplicate input, migration.
acceptance: Zero unauthorized side effects/false success in seeded cases
items.next: Write the acceptance test plan and the first failing vertical-slice fixtures; integrate incrementally across OP-03..21.

items.title: Five-project dogfood pilot and honest positioning
items.scope: Permitted/sanitized real work across software and non-coding tasks; track status checks, completion/intervention, stall detection, summary accuracy, time/cost, notification usefulness.
acceptance: Demo and draft copy reflecting only working capabilities
items.next: Blocked on OP-11, OP-13, OP-17, OP-19, OP-20 and OP-22.

items.title: Packaging, release candidate and rollback runbook
